---
title: "Knowledge Quest"
body-classes: quiz-page
---

<div class="quiz-intro">
<div class="page-heading">
<p class="eyebrow">A five-minute refresher</p>
<h1>Knowledge Quest</h1>
<p>Take a quick quiz on what the survey can tell us—and what it can’t. Every answer comes with a short explanation, so it’s a game and a recap.</p>
</div>
<div class="quiz-art" aria-hidden="true"><span>mind <b>↔</b> body</span></div>
</div>

<section class="quiz-panel" aria-label="Knowledge Quest quiz">
<div class="quiz-topline">
<span id="quiz-count">Question 1 of 6</span>
<span id="quiz-streak">✨ Ready?</span>
</div>
<div class="quiz-progress" role="progressbar" aria-label="Quiz progress" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="6" aria-valuenow="0">
<span id="quiz-progress-fill"></span>
</div>
<h2 class="quiz-question" id="quiz-question" tabindex="-1"></h2>
<div class="quiz-options" id="quiz-options"></div>
<p class="quiz-feedback" id="quiz-feedback" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
<div class="quiz-actions" id="quiz-actions">
<span class="quiz-score" id="quiz-score" aria-live="polite">Score: 0</span>
<button class="button button-primary quiz-next" id="quiz-next" type="button" hidden>Next question <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
</div>
<div class="quiz-results" id="quiz-results" aria-live="polite" hidden>
<div class="quiz-results-mark" aria-hidden="true">✦</div>
<h2 id="quiz-results-title">Quest complete!</h2>
<p id="quiz-results-score"></p>
<div class="quiz-takeaway"><strong>Keep this in mind:</strong> These are unweighted, descriptive patterns in one survey sample. They do not show cause and effect, diagnose anyone, or measure overall immune strength.</div>
<button class="button button-primary" id="quiz-restart" type="button">Play again <span aria-hidden="true">↻</span></button>
</div>
</section>

<p class="quiz-note">Just for learning—not a health assessment. This quiz uses the same definitions and cautions as the project’s <a href="methods.html">methods</a> and <a href="story.html">findings</a>.</p>
